decisions.reason: This numbering software supports the firm's push into digital variable-data printing and traceability, so it is worth keeping despite some risk that it could be absorbed into a broader software suite.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces strengthens the core marking portfolio in a clear customer need area, making withdrawal unlikely for a growing supplier.

The code-decoding app fits the digitalization and traceability direction, but as a more adjacent software tool with less direct hardware lock-in it faces a higher chance of being discontinued if adoption stays limited.
Inline code verification is highly complementary to the firm's coding and compliance offer, so it is strategically important and likely to stay on the market.
Print layout design software supports common operation across systems and customer integration, so the firm would usually retain it unless it is later bundled or replaced by a newer platform.
